reference_route.parade_scope: FL5801 is a USB2 hub with customizable Billboard and PD-bridge functions. This does not establish that DEG2 enables a readable PD bridge.
reference_route.infineon_code: The inspected FL5801 helper reads a16-byte UUID over the reference-board I2C master. It is not a host USB PD-log reader. USB descriptors default to VID04b4 but initialization overwrites VID/PID from the configuration table. Its vendor transport uses bulk OUT01 and interrupt IN82, both64 bytes. No DEG2 command compatibility follows.
reference_route.fwupd_scope: Fresco-PD selects7102/7112, not5801. CCGX-DMC identifies1d5c:5801 as a parent hub for an HP dock, with a separate DMC device. No041f:d002 match in the inspected quirk files. Similar manufacturer names do not qualify those update/read protocols for DEG2.
reference_route.sdk_access: This Griffin Creek reference source is public without SDK login. It is a different dock platform, not the missing ASUS AMD host implementation. Host SDK login may still add the AMD/PS8830 source identified earlier.
